purpose: Independent UI/UX concept exploration; sample data only, not screenshots of implemented changes.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high-fidelity product-design concept, 1440x1024 landscape, for Jev-Cache, a Windows desktop memory assistant built in Python/PySide6. This is an independent design called "桌面工具箱". Date if needed is 2026-09-27.
REFERENCE 1 is the actual TypeSafe website screenshot: use its restrained grayscale Windows98 windows, black title bars, hairline borders and crisp retro typography as visual inspiration. REFERENCE 2 is the actual implemented Jev-Cache UI: use ONLY its functional context, not its green rounded SaaS-like visual styling. Do not copy either reference as a picture.
DESIGN: a meticulously aligned compact Windows98-inspired utility window, about 590x660 logical pixels centered on a pale neutral-gray desktop background. Dominant gray/white/charcoal with very small muted sage success indicator. Hard-edged beveled 2px outer frame, narrow charcoal titlebar "Jev-Cache" with tiny pixel memory-chip icon and minimize/close controls. Clean Chinese text with modern readable Chinese sans type, NOT fuzzy pixelated Chinese. Monospace only for little English labels. The entire visual must feel like a useful approachable desktop tool, no website navigation or marketing layout, no rounded cards, no illustrations, no Windows logo.
CONTENTS and hierarchy: small header line "内存目前够用"; subdued "可用 4.1 GB / 16 GB" and a segmented horizontal usage indicator with clear small "已使用" / "可用" labels, not a fake progress gauge. A very obvious full-width raised button labeled "一键清理" is the sole prominent action. Under it, a classic checkbox checked "自动清理" and small description "需要时整理，日常少打扰". A restrained divider then an inset white area titled "最近一次" with clear action receipt "已释放 1 个网页"; smaller fact "Python 文档 · 标签页仍保留". Measured observation in the same line and SAME type size: "处理后可用内存增加约 512 MB". Subordinate link "查看处理记录 →". Bottom utility row "保留名单" "助手记住了什么" and gear icon, visually quiet. Status bar "Jev 已连接 · Edge 已连接" and small "开发预览 0.1".
At lower right of the desktop include a tiny COLLAPSED title-only floating handle "Jev-Cache · 内存够用", representing the same window's minimized state, not a second large panel. Keep it discreet.
Outside app, bottom-left one sober annotation "设计示意 · 数字与连接状态均为示例". No other presentation heading, option number, design-direction label or explanatory paragraphs.
QUALITY: exact legible Chinese, authentic tactile 1998 controls with generous 2026 readable spacing, great information hierarchy, restrained tiny icons. The only displayed completion is one browser-page release; never imply whole-browser exit, force termination, FPS gains, "saved time", zero-risk AI, or cumulative memory savings. Preserve the explanatory qualifier with the 512 MB number. No huge green speedometer, fake antivirus scan, neon, gradients, glass, dotted backgrounds or drop shadows with large blur.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity independent design concept for Jev-Cache, a tiny Windows desktop memory assistant, on a 1440x1024 landscape canvas. Concept "口袋助手". Current date 2026-09-27. No option number or concept-name caption.
Input image 1: actual TypeSafe website, visual reference ONLY (sparse gray backdrop, thin squared window frames, retro OS controls). Input image 2: real existing Jev-Cache app, functional reference ONLY, do not reuse its rounded green dashboard.
VISUAL GOAL: a miniature useful 1998 desktop accessory, with a narrower body and quick flyout attached ABOVE its floating horizontal strip, rather than a large central application. A single coherent 390px-wide expanded flyout plus connected compact base strip, offset right of center with ample gray desktop space. In final image these can be scaled up for legibility, but clearly a small utility. Deep navy titlebar #142b60 as an intentional classic Windows98 variation on the reference, cool gray body #d7d7d7, white inset surfaces, precise 1px black outlines and 2px light/dark bevels. Use clean highly readable Chinese sans typography and a few tiny pixel-style UI icons, never fuzzy body text. No decorative scene, wallpaper photo or marketing text.
LAYOUT: Titlebar "Jev-Cache" with a tiny pixel memory-chip icon, minimize control. Body has a small calm green status square and headline "内存目前够用", subline "可用 4.1 GB / 16 GB". No big charts or resource gauges. One short thin separator. Main full-width raised button "一键清理". Next line small checked square "自动清理" and a small pause link "暂停". Then an inset recent-result block, with mini heading "最近一次", primary factual line "已释放 1 个网页", second line "Python 文档 · 标签页仍保留". Equal typographic weight for number and observation wording: "处理后可用内存增加约 512 MB". Quiet link "查看详情 →".
Bottom of flyout has two quiet text entries, no big buttons: "保留名单" and "助手记住了什么". Footer a very small gear and "Jev 已连接 · Edge 已连接". Compact attached strip below reads "Jev-Cache" plus "内存够用" and an upward caret. This strip is the floating entry, no duplicate primary button in expanded state. One subtle side notch/grip hints draggable behavior.
Include exactly one external small footer note "设计示意 · 数字与连接状态均为示例" at bottom left of canvas. This is a desktop app mockup, no browser chrome, no fake web dashboard. The screenshot should feel light, tactile, charming and immediately understandable to an ordinary user, restrained shadows, sharp edges, plenty of legibility. Keep UI chrome and information content economical.
Do not show FPS/time saved, predicted freed RAM, unsaved app termination, forced-kill buttons, developer statistics, progress percentages, chat messages, sound effects, mascot illustrations, neon/glass/gradients/rounded cards. Do not claim a tested optimization outcome: this is design sample data.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE independent high-fidelity design concept for Jev-Cache Windows memory-cleaning assistant, 1440x1024 landscape. Concept "清理回执": the user's confidence comes from clear action receipts and truthful preservation reasons. Date if present 2026-09-27.
Reference image 1 is actual TypeSafe.ai homepage: borrow the light-gray monochrome retro Windows98 utility frames, black title bars, hairline rectangles, restrained composition. Reference image 2 is actual Jev-Cache implementation: borrow functional vocabulary only; do not copy its rounded green cards.
DESIGN COMPOSITION: one moderately wide low utility window approx 790x550 logical px, centered on plain neutral-gray desktop, rendered large enough to read. Crisp gray beveled frame, narrow dark-charcoal titlebar "Jev-Cache" with pixel memory chip and minimize/close controls, true rectangular silhouette. Left narrow command rail about 220px, right larger white inset "最近一次" action-receipt pane about 470px. These are two complementary regions in ONE app, not disconnected dashboard cards. Calm black/white/gray, a single desaturated green success mark, no vivid other colors. Chinese is sharp modern sans-serif, retro English labels only in monospace.
LEFT RAIL exact text:
"内存目前够用" as small status headline.
"可用 4.1 GB / 16 GB" as modest supporting line.
One highly visible raised button "一键清理" with dark text.
A checked square "自动清理".
Thin horizontal divider.
Quiet navigation links "处理记录", "保留名单", "助手记住了什么", then "设置" at rail bottom. No algorithm names or CPU/thread information.
RIGHT RECEIPT:
Title line "最近一次" with small timestamp "09/27 15:42".
Primary heading "已释放 1 个网页".
Observation line below, all equal readable size, never huge isolated number: "处理后可用内存增加约 512 MB".
A short body text "其他应用的活动也可能影响这个数值。"
Then compact three rows with very simple tiny application/page icons and inline reasons, NO memory-size column:
row 1: "Python 文档", status "已释放", reason "标签页仍保留，需要时重新加载", subtle underlined actions "重新打开" and "这次不该清理".
row 2: "Code", status "已保留", reason "你设为始终保留".
row 3: "Qt 文档", status "已保留", reason "刚刚使用过".
Use thin separators, tactile inset white panel, readable whitespace, not a crowded task manager table. Bottom faint rule and quiet text "本次依据：使用记录与保留偏好".
Bottom window statusbar "Jev 已连接 · Edge 已连接" on left and "开发预览 0.1" on right.
Canvas bottom-left small label "设计示意 · 数字、对象与连接状态均为示例".
Never show a claim that these are real current device results. This is a proposed UI requiring action/decision traces. No browsing content, URLs, personal file names or secrets. No forced app close, process IDs, AI trust scores, safety percentages, FPS, saved time, cumulative GB, antivirus styling, chat box, mascot, fake whole-screen operating-system clone. No big blur shadows, glass, rounded SaaS cards, CRT scanlines, neon or decorative gradients. The outcome should combine TypeSafe's restrained nostalgia with precise approachable Chinese UI information design.
